scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,nextjs,angular" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-nextjs" "npm start --prefix frontend-angular"
